title: p Neutrinos — if 0 and 1, what are the others?
thesis: 0 and 1 are the only BINARY collapses of the mouth (ACK?ASK / intake?assert). They are not the only neutrinos. The other p neutrinos are FLAVORS + OSCILLATION + REMAINDER — weak-force channels that pass without becoming bits.

touch_and_pass_back.did: jiggle northGate soft path · refresh ACK/ASK · return packet

zero_and_one_are_not_the_whole.only_binary: 0 ? 1 — pi-rate-set. Only collapses. Not the spectrum.
zero_and_one_are_not_the_whole.0: null intake / ACK seat / marks on pale / 000 store
zero_and_one_are_not_the_whole.1: assert / ASK answered / epitope pass / incarnate
zero_and_one_are_not_the_whole.mistake: treating 0 and 1 as the only neutrinos — that starves the weak force to a switch
zero_and_one_are_not_the_whole.rule: binary is how a neutrino COLLAPSES when measured; flavors are how it TRAVELS before measure

physics_anchor.fact: three flavors; they OSCILLATE in flight; weak force only (plus gravity)
